title: System Design for AI Applications
content: Understanding why a system design problem arises is crucial. These are not just model problems; they are system design problems. Additionally, AI does not replace traditional system design; rather, it builds upon existing infrastructure. Key components such as databases, APIs, authentication, security, caching, queues, observability, and scalable infrastructure are still essential. An AI engineer who focuses solely on models but lacks understanding of software architecture may face challenges. Conversely, a traditional software engineer who ignores AI architecture might miss how modern applications are evolving. The intersection between AI and traditional system design is interesting. For example, imagine someone asks to design something like ChatGPT. This thought experiment highlights the need for a combined understanding of both fields.
